description: Dependent FMA chain of fixed length laid out as a straight-line loop body of body_ops FMAs, one kernel per body size, so the number of dependent FMAs executed stays constant while the code footprint changes; loop-control work does not (smaller bodies run more iterations), so cold and primed times are paired within one body size. Entry is: query the selected kernel's attributes to request that the runtime load it without running it (whether that fully pre-loads it requires target qualification), optional clock/cache warmer, prime_launches untimed launches of the same kernel, then one timed launch. prime_launches=0 is the default cold entry (first dispatch of the kernel in the process), prime_launches=1 is an explicit primed exception. A primer stores to its own output buffer. The primer remains when the warmer is disabled, including trace capture. Derive the first-dispatch minus primed-dispatch GPU event time downstream and fit it against the measured code bytes of each compiled kernel; reading its slope as instruction-fetch cost, and any cache-level attribution, requires target qualification.

scaling_param.name: body_ops
scaling_param.description: FMAs in the straight-line loop body; selects the kernel fetch_kernel_<body_ops> and with it the static code footprint

non_scaling_params.name: total_ops
non_scaling_params.description: FMAs executed per thread (loop iterations = total_ops / body_ops); must be a positive multiple of body_ops, at most 1048576. Held constant so the number of FMAs executed does not change with body_ops

non_scaling_params.name: prime_launches
non_scaling_params.description: Untimed launches of the same kernel between the warmer and the timed launch: 0 = cold entry (timed launch is the first dispatch), 1 = kernel dispatched once before timing

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid; the declared sweep uses one block so a single SM/CU fetches the code

non_scaling_params.name: threads_per_block
non_scaling_params.description: Number of threads per block; the declared value is one AMD wavefront

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the clock/cache warmer BEFORE any untimed primer launch. False skips only the warmer; a requested primer still runs. It does not promise a particular cache or clock state.
